detail.longDescription: Interesting research: > Pharmacogenes can change the way people metabolize drugs such that they need higher or lower doses, worsen or introduce new side effects, and in some cases make drugs entirely ineffective. The variants included in the study affect the functioning of drugs including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, statins, chemotherapy, and the blood thinner Plavix, among others. https://www. statnews.com/2026/11/11/all-of -us-study-finds-gene-variants-drug-responses/ # medicine # health # drugs # genetics # research 1/2
